heads.la: EPISTOLA PRIMA. ERNISII ABBATIS ET R. PRIORIS S. VICTORIS PARIS. AD ROBERTUM HEREFORDIENSEM.
heads.en: LETTER ONE. [n: ( Epist S. Thomae Cantuar. edit. GILES. t. II, p. 200.)] OF ERNISIUS THE ABBOT AND R. THE PRIOR OF ST VICTOR OF PARIS, TO ROBERT OF HEREFORD.

heads.la: EPISTOLA II. PRIORIS S. VICTORIS PARIS. ET R. ABBATIS S. AUGUSTINI AD ALEXANDRUM PAPAM.
heads.en: LETTER II. OF THE PRIOR OF ST VICTOR OF PARIS AND R. THE ABBOT OF ST AUGUSTINE, TO POPE ALEXANDER.[n: ( Ibid. )]

heads.la: EPISTOLA III. WILLELMI PRIORIS URSICAMPI AD RICHARDUM PRIOREM S. VICTORIS. Petit aliquod ex ejus opusculis describendum.
heads.en: LETTER III. OF WILLIAM, PRIOR OF OURSCAMP, TO RICHARD, PRIOR OF ST VICTOR. He asks that one of his little works be copied out. [n: (MARTENE, Ampl. Collect., VI, 235.)]

heads.la: EPISTOLA IV. G. PRESBYTERI ANILCURTENSIS AD RICHARDUM PRIOREM S. VICTORIS. Petit ab eo Passionem sive lectiones novem de S. Victore, inserendas in Breviario.
heads.en: LETTER IV. OF G., PRIEST OF ANILCOURT, TO RICHARD, PRIOR OF ST VICTOR. He asks of him the Passion, or the nine lessons concerning St Victor, to be inserted in a Breviary. [n: (MARTENE, ibid. )]

heads.la: EPISTOLA V. G. AD RICHARDUM PRIOREM S. VICTORIS. Cupit rescire quid cum rege et abbate S. Germani egerit pro suo negotio.
heads.en: LETTER V. OF G. TO RICHARD, PRIOR OF ST VICTOR. He desires to learn what he has transacted with the king and the abbot of St Germain concerning his affair. [n: (MARTENE, ibid., col. 237.)]
